name: MARIA BC
description: MARIA BC performs a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 26, 2026, starting at 10 PM.
longDescription:
MARIA BC is set to perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event takes place on November 26, 2026, with a start time of 10 PM.

The concert has an age rating of 16 and above. Tickets are priced at 10€ for general admission.

The venue, Radioclube Agramonte, is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto. The performance is expected to last 60 minutes.
